children: Healthcare product maker's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 28% yr/yr, led by 93% U.S. growth
Gross margin improved to 39% from 38% on higher revenue and better manufacturing processes
Company reported first-ever positive net income before taxes, reflecting higher revenue and stable expenses
Company anticipates potential product launch with U.S. skincare partner in summer 2027
Sonoma expects Taiwan market entry pending regulatory approval and initial purchase order
Company sees growth opportunities in senior-care market for HOCl products
U.S. DEMAND - Co said 93% U.S. revenue growth was driven by higher demand and increased sales from new and existing distributors
MANUFACTURING AND CUSTOMER MIX - Co attributed higher gross margin to improved manufacturing processes and changes in customer mix
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Co said stable operating expenses alongside revenue growth demonstrated operating leverage
